text: Entry Requirements Foreign citizens: Over 18 years old, in good health, Graduates of Senior High School or above. Students who are applying for Harbin Engineering University must be Non-Chinese citizen or from Hong Kong, Taiwan or Macao with good health. Friendly to China and respect Chinese social morality and customs. Obeyed the law of People's Republic of China and the rules & regulations of HEU with good characteristics; Students who are diligent and studious with excellent academic results. HSK grade certificate copy(Band 4 at least).
